snippet.title: Infinite Minesweeper gameplay
snippet.description:
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.grykuby.minesweeper
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/infinite-minesweeper-grykuby/id6476042029

Gameplay of the new relaxing variety of the famous Windows minesweeper game. The infinite game board is made of 8x8 chunks. Solve them, feel the satisfaction and score points.
